Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

on the tip of my tongue phrase

also it was on the tip of my tongue, at the tip of my tongue

classical

Plaut. Trin. 4.2.65: versābātur mihi in labrīs prīmōribus (Lewis & Short s.v. prīmōris)
Traupman 109: erat in labrīs prīmōribus
Traupman 259, 395

in labrīs prīmōribus versārī

prīmōrēs, prīmōrum, the front part, with labrum, labrī n., lip

be on the tip of one’s tongue

Latin keeps the word on the front of the lips, not the tip of the tongue. Prīmōribus labrīs attingere is something else: to touch a subject lightly (Cic. de Or. 1.87).

Examples

  • Erat in labrīs prīmōribus.

    It was on the tip of my tongue.Traupman 395

See also escape, forget.
